hint.text: If something is sacred, it is holy, or very important to someone’s religion.
hint.label: Sacred

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The most sacred texts for Jewish people are the Tanakh and the Talmud. The Tanakh has 24 books and is split into three sections. The first section, the Torah, is considered the most important of the three parts. The Talmud is the collection of the teachings of rabbis, the religious leaders of Judaism.

atoms.a: Which word in the text means the religious leaders of Judaism?
What is the most important section of the Tanakh?
atoms.sound: What is the most important section of the Tanakh?

atoms.a: How many books does the Tanakh have?

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: For Christians, the most important religious text is the Bible. There are two parts to the Bible: the Old Testament and the New Testament. The Old Testament refers to the set of books that take place before the birth of Jesus Christ. The books of the Old Testament contain parts which are also considered holy scripture for people who practice Judaism. The New Testament is the set of books that take place during and after the life of Jesus.

atoms.a: Which part of the Bible takes place after the death of Jesus Christ?
Which part of the Bible includes books which are also important for Jewish people?

atoms.text: The holiest book for Muslims (the name for people who practice Islam) is the Qur’an. The Qur’an describes the nature of God according to Islamic faith. According to Muslims, the angel Jibril revealed the word of God or Allah to the prophet Muhammad. Muhammad then wrote it down and spread the word to his followers.
